description: Authoritative registry of headless conformance suites across all RFC domains. This is the single owner of which suites exist, what they cover, how they build, and their expected outcome. Domains add ONE row here when they land a new conformance suite; the shared runner (tools/quality/conformance.py) builds, runs, and evidences every row uniformly so a suite can never silently drift out of the gate. Profiles own toolchain/flag facts (quality/profiles/); this manifest references them by id.

suites.description: RFC 0011 G4: the radiosity producer's patch gather, probe gather and composition on the job system's batch executor with 1, 2 and N real worker threads produce the serial oracle's bytes exactly over a 40000-patch synthetic stress transfer

jobsystem.radiosity under ThreadSanitizer (the stress configuration). Needs a compiler with a TSan runtime: CONFORMANCE_TSAN=1 python3 tools/quality/conformance.py check --cxx clang++ --suite jobsystem.radiosity.tsan
The TSan lane's negative control: jobsystem.radiosity with a seeded unsynchronized counter written by concurrent batch items (-DRADIOSITY_SEED_RACE) must fail under ThreadSanitizer

RFC 0011 producer contract: the shared suite passes the Baked producer, the precomputed radiosity producer (BakedPlusDelta over the furnace transfer) and a scripted fake, and rejects each of the seven deliberately bad producers and a one-bounce radiosity producer; render.indirect-switching's scenarios (baked <-> fake, a failed Begin, device loss mid-fade, backgrounding, map change) against a fake GPU timeline

RFC 0011 baked direct light blocked by moving geometry (render/direct_occlusion.h) on a synthetic floor: no occluder leaves the bake's bytes; a box between the floor and a rectangle light, or under a distant light, takes exactly the direct light of the texels it shadows (the sun's footprint only) and leaves the rest as baked; a box beside every path or behind the lit side changes nothing; a box over the centre takes a sphere's or a spot's direct light, and a box on the path to a corner darkens it under the sphere but not under the spot, whose cone never reaches it; no lights, nothing built

RFC 0011 G6 SDF GI CPU benchmark (unittests/rendertest/indirect_sdf_bench.cpp) in its smoke mode: the SDF-traced producer on the contract scene against a host-memory compute service, and the baked direct light's occlusion on a synthetic floor. Every sample is checked: the unchanged scene publishes the bake byte for byte, a converged probe publishes the bake times the field's ratio, the change atlas is published minus baked, occlusion without proxies is the bake, and pooled compose is serial compose byte for byte. The same program measures the performance fixtures of tools/quality/gi_sdf_bench.py (quality/budgets/indirect-sdf-perf-v1.json)

RFC 0011 G4 precomputed radiosity: the furnace enclosure's absolute solve reaches the infinite-bounce value within 2% in the declared convergenceFrames from a cold start and the one-bounce defect never does; switched states match the independent Python solve; the producer publishes the bake exactly at baked scalars, follows a light style, returns to the bake and idles in a still scene
RFC 0011 indirect-light policy: table, availability and the furnace composition
seeded: the total layer read under the RuntimeIndirect variant must fail the furnace
RFC 0011 runtime light set: stable IDs, style scalars, baked-state comparison, epochs and value semantics over a scripted frame sequence
seeded: dynamic IDs from table slots (ID reuse) must be rejected
seeded: style scalars ignored must be rejected
seeded: a non-advancing epoch must be rejected
RFC 0011 spark-burst light: the original trail ramp, emission-weighted centroid, fade against the burst's peak, batching and the burst budget
seeded: a centroid and strength that ignore each spark's emission must be rejected
seeded: a burst light that never fades must be rejected
seeded: a budget that keeps released places must be rejected
seeded: a burst whose light follows sparks beyond its reach (fallen out of the world) must be rejected
RFC 0011 direct-light budget: the strongest unbaked lights at the viewer, by luminance, falloff and view coverage, with deterministic ties
seeded: the original first-in-table-order choice must be rejected
seeded: a ranking that ignores the view must be rejected
seeded: ties to the higher ID must be rejected
Particle collision plane crossing: a particle starting on a surface and moving into it hits it; leaving, sliding and backside particles do not
seeded: the original predicate, which lets a particle on a surface fall through it, must be rejected

Portal 2 blobulator tiler CPU mesh (clean-room ImpTiler): lone-particle spheres at retail, low-res and fine grids (vertices on the sphere, field at threshold, outward normals, winding, tangent frames), bitwise-welded closed oriented manifolds with Euler 2 and positive volume, tile seams at negative coordinates and per-tile independence, bridging, determinism, scale-0, sorted build and factory counts, with negative controls for each checker. RFC 0011 G5 compute foundation on a headless device: capabilities queried and enabled through the VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 chain and claimed only as enabled (a provider claiming unenabled ray query is rejected); a compute program writes a storage buffer and an R32F storage image on the graphics queue, read back exactly; a retired resource lives until its submission completes and the seeded early free is caught; validation-clean with the layer. RFC 0011 G6/G7 traced producers on a headless device through the renderer's compute service (render/gpu_compute.h over vulkan_compute's GpuComputeService): the shared producer suite (unittests/rendertest/indirect_contract.h) against the SDF-traced producer and, on a device with ray query, the ray-query producer (the contract scene's triangles as a scene with proxy-box instances), including the geometry oracle (a proxy box around a probe darkens it below 5% of the seed); each traced field's own reference sees no light through the thin wall, and erasing the wall (from the field, or its triangles) is detected; without ray query the ray-query producer fails with missing-feature and creates nothing; sphere and spot lights (SDFV v2) match L r^2 / d^2 cos per texel and the spot's cone leaves a probe outside it unlit (the sphere lights it); a light cell that omits the light leaves its probe unlit; a focus of probe 0 without a budget references probe 0 only, a focus of every probe is the no-focus schedule byte for byte, after a change a focused probe updates while an unfocused one waits, and a budget brings every probe to rest; validation-clean with the layer. shaders/pbr_brdf.glsl, the BRDF every native PBR stage includes, evaluated in a compute program on a headless device and compared with public/render/pbr_brdf.h on 1,080 cases (GGX, Smith, Schlick, the single-scatter lobe, multiple-scattering compensation and directional albedo, clear coat); seeded C++ models without compensation, with alpha = roughness, or with an unweighted coat are rejected by the same comparator; validation-clean with the layer

The PBR and GI stages' descriptor sets grouped by update frequency (vulkan_descriptor_groups.h) on a headless device: equal requests in a frame slot share a set, another view, sampler or group gets its own, slots are independent and recycle only at their BeginFrame, a frame beyond one pool grows the slot's pools, Invalidate forgets the reuse table; the seeded view-only reuse key is caught; validation-clean with the layer

Native Vulkan capture-tool support without a device: material_spv_index.h agrees with material_spv.h (every embedded array's C++ FNV-1a hash is the generator's, a changed bit is unnamed); VulkanShaderLibrary takes a debug variant only for a known hash, well-formed SPIR-V and a device with VK_KHR_shader_non_semantic_info when it imports NonSemantic info, from files and from a directory scan that reports stale, partial and NonSemantic files, and resolves embedded code to it under the embedded name; DebugLabelsWanted's policy table; VulkanDebugUtils over recording entry points is inert until loaded, names objects, and keeps every command buffer's labels balanced over 200 seeded push/pop/insert/frame sequences, with controls proving the balance check rejects unclosed and unopened labels

Gap corpus (R01 re-audit, item 6): diagnoses why gi_reference.py check reports 0 pixels for every region of portal-light's room camera. An independent numpy ray caster over the fixture's authored .usda meshes first agrees with the recorded Cycles index images for the joined camera (per-object counts within 2%, >= 97% per-pixel agreement). Cast from the room camera's map-space pose into the reference stage, it sees only the back of room B's east wall, as the recorded closed.room/open.room images do. The room camera is the joined camera shifted by the portal offset (fixture reference_cameras room -> joined, which only gi_runtime honors). It sees every region in map.usda, and gi_reference.py check's zero-pixel lines are exactly the room camera's. Needs numpy and Pillow; about 25 s.

Negative control for corpus.gi.portal-light-room-camera: the ray caster's image is mirrored. The per-object counts are unchanged by a mirror, so only the per-pixel cross-check against the Cycles index image can reject it, and it must.

Negative control and fix hypothesis for corpus.gi.portal-light-room-camera: the room camera is replaced by its declared reference camera (joined). The reproduction must no longer hold, because the aliased camera sees the floor, model and walls in the reference stage.

Gap corpus (item 1): Clang/64-bit legacy sweep. Re-records compile commands (./waf clangdb, no build) in seven private trees (tests, tools, dedicated, portal-native, portal-dxvk [GCC-configured, compiled by Clang], hl2, portal2-native), then runs every recorded cxx20-permissive compile (~10,600 TUs) through clang++ -fsyntax-only with only the 64-bit hazard set enabled: the pointer-to-smaller-int cast error that GCC -fpermissive -w hides, -Wint-to-pointer-cast, -Wint-to-void-pointer-cast, LP64 printf width mismatches (-Wformat) and pointer-sized integers narrowed to 32 bits (-Wshorten-64-to-32 from intp/uintp/intptr_t/uintptr_t/VPANEL). Exact ratchet against quality/fixtures/corpus/clang64/sites.json: a new site, a stale site, or a permissive target entering or leaving coverage fails. About 6 minutes at 16 jobs. Setup (once): python3 tools/quality/corpus/clang64_sweep.py setup --dxvk-root <DXVK Native prefix>. Re-record after review: python3 tools/quality/corpus/clang64_sweep.py record.

Negative control for corpus.clang64.sweep: a seeded TU with vrad's pre-ad7120f3 pattern (the address of a stack EnumContext_t cast to int and passed through an intp context parameter), an int widened to void* and a %d of a size_t, compiled with the permissive product flags (-std=c++20 -fpermissive -w) through the same translate/sweep/ratchet path. Its sites are not in the inventory and must be reported as new, the truncation first. Needs no build tree.

Negative control for corpus.clang64.sweep on the real defect: utils/vrad/vraddisps.cpp as of ad7120f3^ (git show) compiled with vrad's recorded argv from the tools tree. Both (int)&ctx enumeration contexts (lines 565 and 578; GCC -fpermissive only warns and -w hides it) must be reported as new sites. Setup: python3 tools/quality/corpus/clang64_sweep.py setup --config tools.

Paired control for corpus.clang64.historical-vraddisps: the same command on the checked-out utils/vrad/vraddisps.cpp (--rev WORKTREE, with the intp fix) reports no site outside the inventory, so the historical row fails because of the old bytes and not the harness. Setup: python3 tools/quality/corpus/clang64_sweep.py setup --config tools.

Gap corpus (R01 re-audit, item 2), start of R48's byte-identical legacy lump and PVS gate. Four authored maps (box room; power-3 displacement hump between a light and two sewn power-2 displacement floors; three rooms on a dogleg with func_detail; light_environment through a sky chimney plus light_spot) are compiled vbsp -> vvis -> vrad -ldr -> vrad -hdr by the declared executables, twice (the two compiles must agree), and all 64 lumps of each BSP are compared byte for byte with quality/fixtures/corpus/compile/expected.json, recorded by the legacy executables built at 294066c6 (and reproduced identically by the pre-fix ad7120f3^ build). An independent stdlib reader decodes the PVS per cluster and checks authored visibility (room A sees B, A and C hidden from each other). Determinism policy: -threads 1 and ASLR off (setarch -R), because legacy VRAD's supersampling reads uninitialized stack memory; DISPINFO bytes VBSP never writes are masked. Setup: WAFLOCK=.lock-waf-corpus-tools ./waf configure --tools --disable-warns -T release -o build-corpus-tools --prefix=$PWD/build-corpus-tools/install && WAFLOCK=.lock-waf-corpus-tools ./waf build -j8 && WAFLOCK=.lock-waf-corpus-tools ./waf install. About 4 s.

Also: two builds are byte-identical stage for stage; a divided room hides its two halves from each other; a 7-sided chamfered solid compiles. Negative fixtures each fail with their code and leave the store unchanged: a bad seal (compile.leak), a missing model, a physics model without collision, a missing material, a reserved role, a role changed against the published package, an unresolved prefab reference, a stale surface id after a clip, an unsupported light input. Seeded mutants of the compiler (swapped st axes, dropped face, shuffled provenance, doubled light, moved entity, skipped vvis, skipped driver leak test) are caught.
